lines.en: Clara, you said that last Saturday was a day you would never forget. What happened?
lines.pt: Clara, você disse que sábado passado foi um dia que nunca esqueceria. O que aconteceu?

lines.en: At first, it was an ordinary morning. I was cycling in the park when I heard a strange noise behind a bush.
lines.pt: No começo, foi uma manhã comum. Eu pedalava no parque quando ouvi um barulho estranho atrás de um arbusto.

lines.en: Oh no. Had somebody fallen off a bike, or was it an animal?
lines.pt: Ai, não. Alguém tinha caído da bicicleta, ou era um animal?

lines.en: It was a tiny puppy. Someone had left him there, and he had obviously been crying for a long time.
lines.pt: Era um filhote pequenininho. Alguém o tinha deixado ali, e ele obviamente chorava havia muito tempo.

lines.en: Poor thing! What did you do then? I think I would have been very worried.
lines.pt: Coitadinho! O que você fez então? Acho que eu teria ficado muito preocupada.

lines.en: Suddenly, a woman ran towards us. She had been searching for her dog since sunrise, and she was in tears.
lines.pt: De repente, uma mulher correu na nossa direção. Ela procurava o cachorro desde o nascer do sol, e estava em lágrimas.

lines.en: That is lovely! Did she explain how he had escaped?
lines.pt: Que lindo! Ela explicou como ele tinha fugido?

lines.en: Yes. While she was talking on the phone, he had slipped out of the gate. By the time she noticed, he had run off.
lines.pt: Sim. Enquanto ela falava ao telefone, ele tinha escapulido pelo portão. Quando ela notou, ele já tinha saído correndo.

lines.en: And then? I suppose she thanked you for ages.
lines.pt: E depois? Imagino que ela tenha agradecido por horas.

lines.en: In the end, she invited me for coffee, and afterwards we walked the puppy home together. We have been friends ever since.
lines.pt: No fim, ela me convidou para um café, e depois levamos o filhote para casa juntas. Somos amigas desde então.

lines.en: What a story! I hope that the next time I go cycling, something like that happens to me too.
lines.pt: Que história! Espero que da próxima vez que eu pedalar, algo assim aconteça comigo também.

facts.big: passado simples + was/were -ing + had + particípio + conectores
facts.label: Narrativa pessoal
facts.sub: Eventos: passado simples. Cenário: was cycling. Antes: had been, had left. Conectores: at first, suddenly, by the time, in the end, afterwards.

facts.label: At first / In the end
facts.sub: Use at first para abrir e in the end para fechar: At first, it was ordinary. In the end, we became friends. Conectores marcam as etapas e deixam a narrativa clara para quem ouve.

facts.label: Suddenly
facts.sub: Suddenly e all of a sudden anunciam uma mudança: Suddenly, a woman ran towards us. Depois deles, use o passado simples para a ação nova. O fundo da cena fica no passado contínuo.

items.s: The past simple tells the main events of a story.
The past perfect shows an earlier event.
We say “At the first, it was ordinary”.

answers: The past simple tells the main events of a story. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
The past perfect shows an earlier event. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “At the first, it was ordinary”. → Falso (We say at first.)
